title: Distribution of a random maximal path prefix
statement: For every natural number $n$, choose a permutation of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ uniformly at random and independently choose $k$ uniformly from $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$. The set of the first $k$ elements in the permutation has the same probability distribution as first choosing $k$ uniformly from that range and then choosing a $k$-element subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$ uniformly at random.
